claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
The main show for both nights of WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET / 3 p.m. PT.
The pre-show coverage for WrestleMania 42 begins at 3 p.m. ET / noon PT.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on the ESPN App in the US.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix internationally.
The first hour of each night of WrestleMania 42 will simulcast on cable television for the first time.
The first hour of Saturday night of WrestleMania 42 will simulcast on ESPN2.
The first hour of Sunday night of WrestleMania 42 will simulcast on ESPN.
